integrity: Proof reconstruction, exact symbolic identity checks and finite ODE illustrations performed; numerical checks do not independently establish arbitrary-parameter or infinite-time claims. Historical priority is literature-bounded.
scientific_limitations: One abiotic resource, fixed full local isolation, positive deterministic parameters and strictly ordered break-even concentrations; all strictly positive initial states. Does not cover stochasticity, adaptive isolation, repeated break-even concentrations, or nonlinear uptake. Related older chemostat works were not all accessible in full.
title: Universal critical extinction at successive microbial nutrient-exchange thresholds
